title: cardamine flaccida subsp. alsophila
intro: Cardamine flaccida subsp. alsophila, commonly known as mountain penny cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine flaccida subsp. alsophila include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
